pr_title: kernel: work_q: fix return value in non-error case
pr_body:
A recent patch allowed an error code to be returned even though the
execution path treated it as a non-error condition.  Clear the code
before returning.

Fixes #22933

issue_context.title: k_delayed_work_submit_to_queue returns error code when resubmitting previously completed work.
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
k_delayed_work_submit_to_queue returns error code -EALREADY when submitting previously completed task. Tak is submitted successfully. This response is not covered in doc. This should probably be changed to 0 since error code is propagated from k_delayed_work_cancel. 

**Expected behavior**
0 result - work was submitted to queue. 
OR
response described in doc
comments:
@LuxLuthor Can you specify which commit you are on?
Maybe it is a regression from #22810?
I propose we should revert #22810, fix #22803 by changing the documentation to reflect what the API actually does, and fix #22756 with the alternative solution from #22769.

Clarification: I'm assuming that the bug here is a direct result of the change in API to match documentation by now returning an error from `k_delayed_work_cancel()` where before it returned success.  I take that as a sign that we shouldn't have changed the API in #22810, certainly not at this stage of the release cycle.  @jhedberg 

This particular problem might be fixed by overriding the error return in this case and make it return success value; I don't know, haven't looked closely.  But that won't address any other cases that are going to be discovered.

review_comments: I would pick https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/22933#issuecomment-588287754 as the solution.
That seems like something that should go into work_cancel(), not here, though, right?
Yep, I though about moving that check ou of work_cancel now that you mentioned it might be the right thing to do as a separate patch.
